summary: HEXAGON.md lists the responsibility 'Generate and publish language bindings (Maven artifact, npm package, pip package)'. The contract (§3, D031) says there is no registry and no publish step.
HEXAGON.md says 'Version each contract independently (semver)'. The contract (§2) says there is one repo-wide semver per tag, not per contract.

The CHANGELOG.md header says version files are bumped only for the languages whose output changed. It also says per-contract versioning was only an original intent. The contract (§2) says all three binding version files move at every tag.
HEXAGON.md points open questions to spec-contracts.md §8. In the contract, §8 is 'Planned, not built' and open questions are in §9.
